verses.text: Di words of Amos, wey dey among di shepherds of Tekoa, wey e see concerning Israel for di days of Uzziah king of Judah, and for di days of Jeroboam, Joash pikin, king of Israel, two years before di earthquake.
E talk: “Di Lord go roar from Zion, and utter im voice from Jerusalem. Di pastures of di shepherds go mourn, and di top of Carmel go wither.”
Di Lord talk like dis: “For three transgressions of Damascus, yes, for four, I no go turn away im punishment, because dem don thresh Gilead with threshing sledges of iron.
But I go send fire into di house of Hazael, and e go devour di fortresses of Ben Hadad.
I go break di bar of Damascus, and cut off di inhabitant from di valley of Aven, and im wey hold di sceptre from Beth Eden. Di people of Syria go go into captivity to Kir,” talk di Lord.
Di Lord talk like dis: “For three transgressions of Gaza, yes, for four, I no go turn away im punishment, because dem carry away captive whole communities to deliver dem up to Edom.
But I go send fire on di wall of Gaza, and e go devour im fortresses.
I go cut off di inhabitant from Ashdod, and im wey hold di sceptre from Ashkelon. I go turn my hand against Ekron, and di remnant of di Philistines go perish,” talk di Lord God.
Di Lord talk like dis: “For three transgressions of Tyre, yes, for four, I no go turn away im punishment, because dem deliver up whole communities to Edom, and no remember di brotherly covenant.
But I go send fire on di wall of Tyre, and e go devour im fortresses.”

Di Lord talk like dis: “For three transgressions of Edom, yes, for four, I no go turn away im punishment, because e pursue im brother with di sword, and cast off all pity, and im anger tear perpetually, and e keep im wrath forever.
But I go send fire on Teman, and e go devour di fortresses of Bozrah.”

Di Lord talk like dis: “For three transgressions of di children of Ammon, yes, for four, I no go turn away im punishment, because dem don rip up di pregnant women of Gilead, so that dem go enlarge dem border.
But I go kindle fire for di wall of Rabbah, and e go devour im fortresses, with shouting for di day of battle, with tempest for di day of whirlwind.
Dem king go go into captivity, e and im princes together,” talk di Lord.
Di Lord talk like dis: “For three transgressions of Moab, yes, for four, I no go turn away im punishment, because e burn di bones of di king of Edom into lime.
But I go send fire on Moab, and e go devour di fortresses of Kerioth. Moab go die with tumult, with shouting, and with di sound of di trumpet.
I go cut off di judge from di middle of am, and go kill all im princes with am,” talk di Lord.

Di Lord talk like dis: “For three transgressions of Judah, yes, for four, I no go turn away im punishment, because dem don reject di law of di Lord, and no keep im statutes. Dem lies, after wey dem fathers waka, cause dem to go astray.
But I go send fire on Judah, and e go devour di fortresses of Jerusalem.”
Di Lord talk like dis: “For three transgressions of Israel, yes, for four, I no go turn away im punishment, because dem don sell di righteous for silver, and di needy for pair of sandals,
dem wey pant after di dust of di earth on di head of di poor, and turn aside di path of di humble. Man and im father go in to di same girl, to profane my holy name.
Dem lay down beside every altar on clothes wey dem take for pledge, and for di house of dem God dem drink di wine of dem wey dem don fine.
Yet I destroy di Amorite before dem, whose height na like di height of di cedars, and e dey strong like di oaks. Yet I destroy im fruit from above, and im roots from beneath.
Also I bring una up out of di land of Egypt, and lead una 40 years for di wilderness, to possess di land of di Amorite.
I raise up some of una sons for prophets, and some of una young men for Nazirites. Dis no true, una children of Israel?” talk di Lord.
“But una give di Nazirites wine to drink, and command di prophets, saying, ‘No prophesy.’
See, I go crush una for una place, as cart wey full of sheaves dey crush.
Flight go perish from di swift, and di strong no go strengthen im force, neither di mighty deliver imself.
Neither im wey handle di bow go stand, and im wey dey swift of foot no go deliver imself, neither im wey ride di horse go deliver imself.
Even di courageous among di mighty go flee naked for dat day,” talk di Lord.
Hear dis word wey di Lord don speak against una, children of Israel, against di whole family wey I bring up out of di land of Egypt:
“You only I don choose of all di families of di earth. Therefore I go punish you for all your iniquities.
Two fit waka together, except dem don agree?
Lion go roar for di forest, when e get no prey? Young lion go cry out of im den, if e don catch nothing?
Bird go fall for snare on di earth, where no trap dey for am? Snare go spring up from di ground, if e don catch nothing at all?
Trumpet go blow for di city, and di people no go tremble? Disaster go come to city, and di Lord no do am?
Surely di Lord God go do nothing, without revealing im secret to im servants di prophets.
Di lion don roar. Who no go fear? Di Lord God don speak. Who no go prophesy?”

Proclaim for di palaces of Ashdod, and for di palaces for di land of Egypt, and talk, “Assemble yourselves on di mountains of Samaria, and see di great tumults inside her, and di oppressions for di middle of her.
Dem no know how to do right,” talk di Lord, “wey store up violence and robbery for dem palaces.”
Therefore di Lord God talk like dis: “Adversary go dey round about di land. E go bring down your strength from you, and your palaces go dey plundered.”

Di Lord talk like dis: “As di shepherd rescue out of di mouth of di lion two legs, or piece of ear, so di children of Israel wey dwell for Samaria go dey rescued, with di corner of bed and di silken cushion of couch.
Hear, and testify against di house of Jacob,” talk di Lord God, di God of Armies.
“Because for di day wey I go visit di transgressions of Israel on am, I go also visit di altars of Bethel. Di horns of di altar go dey cut off, and fall to di ground.
I go strike di winter house with di summer house. Di houses of ivory go perish, and di great houses go have end,” talk di Lord.
Hear dis word, una cows of Bashan, wey dey di mountain of Samaria, wey oppress di poor, wey crush di needy, wey talk to dem lords, “Bring, make we drink!”
Di Lord God don swear by im holiness say, “See, di days go come on una, wey dem go take una away with hooks, and di last of una with fish hooks.
Una go go out at di breaches, each straight before am, and una go cast yourselves into Harmon,” talk di Lord.
“Come to Bethel, and sin. For Gilgal multiply disobedience. Bring una sacrifices every morning, and una tithes every three days.
Offer sacrifice of thanksgiving of di leavened bread, and proclaim and publish freewill offerings, because dis na wetin una love, una children of Israel,” talk di Lord God.
“I also don give una cleanness of teeth for all una cities, and lack of bread for all una places, yet una no return to me,” talk di Lord.

“I also don withhold di rain from una, when e remain still three months to di harvest. I cause am to rain upon one city, and I cause am no rain upon another city. One field get rain, and di field wey e no rain on wither.
So two or three cities wander to one city to drink water, and dem no dey satisfied. Yet una no return to me,” talk di Lord.
“I strike una with blight and mildew many times. Di caterpillar devour una gardens and una vineyards and una fig trees and una olive trees. Yet una no return to me,” talk di Lord.

“I send among una plague like di plague of Egypt. Una young men I kill with di sword, and carry away una horses. I make di stench of una camp go up into una nostrils. Yet una no return to me,” talk di Lord.
“I overthrow some among una, as when God overthrow Sodom and Gomorrah, and una dey like brand plucked out of di burning. Yet una no return to me,” talk di Lord.
“Therefore dis na wetin I go do to you, Israel. Because I go do dis to you, prepare to meet your God, Israel.

Because see, na im wey form di mountains, and create di wind, and declare to man wetin im thought be, wey make di morning darkness, and tread on di high places of di earth. Di Lord, di God of Armies, na im name.”
Hear dis word wey I take up for lamentation over una, house of Israel:
“Di virgin of Israel don fall. She no go rise again. She dey forsaken upon her land. None go raise her up.”
Because di Lord God talk like dis: “Di city wey go out by 1,000 go keep 100, and dat wey go out by 100 go keep ten, for di house of Israel.”
Because di Lord talk like dis to di house of Israel: “Seek me, and live,
but no seek Bethel, nor enter into Gilgal, and no pass over to Beersheba. Because Gilgal go surely go into captivity, and Bethel go come to nothing.”
Seek di Lord, and live, lest e break out like fire for di house of Joseph, and e devour am, and nobody dey to quench am for Bethel.
Una wey turn justice to wormwood, and cast down righteousness to di earth,

seek am wey make di Pleiades and Orion, and turn di shadow of death into di morning, and make di day dark with night, wey call for di waters of di sea, and pour dem out on di surface of di earth. Di Lord na im name.
E strengthen di destroyed against di strong, so that destruction come on di fortress.
Dem hate am wey reprove for di gate, and dem abhor am wey speak with integrity.

Therefore, because una trample on di poor, and take taxes of wheat from am, una don build houses of cut stone, but una no go dwell inside dem. Una don plant pleasant vineyards, but una no go drink dem wine.
Because I know say una transgressions dey many, and una sins dey great, una wey afflict di just, wey take bribe, and wey turn aside di needy for di gate.
Therefore di prudent go keep silent for dat time, because na evil time.
Seek good, and no evil, so that una go live. Den di Lord, di God of Armies, go dey with una, as una talk.
Hate evil, and love good, and establish justice for di gate. Maybe di Lord, di God of Armies, go dey gracious to di remnant of Joseph.

Therefore di Lord, di God of Armies, di Lord, talk like dis: “Wailing go dey for all di broad ways. Dem go talk for all di streets, ‘Alas! Alas!’ Dem go call di farmer to mourning, and dem wey dey skilful for lamentation to wailing.
For all di vineyards go dey wailing, because I go pass through di middle of you,” talk di Lord.
Woe to una wey desire di day of di Lord! Wetin di day of di Lord go be to una? E go be darkness, and no light.
As if man flee from lion, and bear meet am, or go into di house, and lean im hand on di wall, and snake bite am.
Di day of di Lord no go be darkness, and no light? Even very dark, and no brightness for am?
“I hate, I despise una feasts, and I no go delight for una solemn assemblies.
Yes, though una offer me una burnt offerings and meal offerings, I no go accept dem. Neither I go regard di peace offerings of una fat animals.
Take away from me di noise of una songs. I no go listen to di melody of una harps.
But make justice roll down like waters, and righteousness like mighty stream.
Una bring to me sacrifices and offerings for di wilderness 40 years, house of Israel?
Una don carry Sikkuth una king and Kiyyun una images, di star of una god, wey una make for yourselves.
Therefore I go cause una to go into captivity beyond Damascus,” talk di Lord, whose name na di God of Armies.
Woe to dem wey dey at ease for Zion, and to dem wey dey secure for di mountain of Samaria, di notable men of di chief of di nations, to whom di house of Israel come!
Pass over to Calneh, and see. From dere go to Hamath di great. Den go down to Gath of di Philistines. Dem dey better pass dis kingdoms? Or dem territory dey greater pass una territory?
Una wey put far away di evil day, and cause di seat of violence to come near.
Dem wey lie on beds of ivory, and stretch demselves on dem couches, and eat di lambs out of di flock, and di calves out of di middle of di stall,
wey sing idle songs to di sound of di harp, and invent for demselves instruments of music, like David,
wey drink wine for bowls, and anoint demselves with di best oils, but dem no grieve for di ruin of Joseph.
Therefore now dem go go into captivity with di first wey go into captivity, and di feasting of dem wey stretch demselves go pass away.
Di Lord God don swear by imself, di Lord, di God of Armies, talk: “I abhor di pride of Jacob, and hate im fortresses. Therefore I go deliver up di city with all wey dey inside am.”
E go happen, if ten men remain for one house, say dem go die.

When man uncle go take am up, even im wey burn am, to bring out di bones from di house, and go talk to am wey dey for di innermost parts of di house, “Anybody still dey with you?” e go talk, “No.” Den e go talk, “Hush! We no go mention di name of di Lord.”
Because see, di Lord command, and e go strike di great house into pieces, and di little house into bits.
Horses go run on di rocky cliff? Man go plow di sea with oxen? But una don turn justice into poison, and di fruit of righteousness into wormwood,
una wey rejoice for nothing, wey talk, “We no take horns for ourselves by our own strength?”
“Because see, I go raise up against una nation, house of Israel,” talk di Lord, di God of Armies, “and dem go afflict una from di entrance of Hamath to di brook of di Arabah.”
Di Lord God show me: see, e form locusts for di beginning of di shooting up of di spring crop. See, na di spring crop after di king mowing.
E happen, when dem don finish eating di grass of di land, say I talk, “Lord God, forgive, I beg you. How Jacob go stand? Because e dey small.”
Di Lord relent concerning dis. “E no go happen,” talk di Lord.
Di Lord God show me: see, di Lord God call for judgment by fire, and e devour di great deep, and e devour di land.
Den I talk, “Lord God, cease, I beg you. How Jacob go stand? Because e dey small.”
Di Lord relent concerning dis. “Dis one no go happen too,” talk di Lord God.
E show me: see, di Lord stand beside wall wey dem build true to plumb, with plumb line for im hand.
Di Lord talk to me, “Amos, wetin you see?” I talk, “Plumb line.” Den di Lord talk, “See, I go set plumb line for di middle of my people Israel. I no go pass by dem again any more.
Di high places of Isaac go dey desolate, and di sanctuaries of Israel go dey laid waste. I go rise against di house of Jeroboam with di sword.”
Den Amaziah di priest of Bethel send to Jeroboam king of Israel, say, “Amos don conspire against you for di middle of di house of Israel. Di land no fit bear all im words.
Because Amos talk like dis: ‘Jeroboam go die by di sword, and Israel go surely dey led away captive out of im land.’”
Amaziah talk to Amos, “You seer, go, flee away into di land of Judah, and dere eat bread, and prophesy dere.
But no prophesy again any more for Bethel, because na di king sanctuary, and na di royal house.”
Den Amos answer Amaziah, “I no be prophet, neither I be prophet son, but I be herdsman, and I tend sycamore figs.
Di Lord take me from following di flock, and di Lord talk to me, ‘Go, prophesy to my people Israel.’
Now therefore hear di word of di Lord: You talk, ‘No prophesy against Israel, and no preach against di house of Isaac.’

Therefore di Lord talk like dis: ‘Your wife go be prostitute for di city, and your sons and your daughters go fall by di sword, and your land go dey divided by line. You go die for unclean land, and Israel go surely go into captivity out of im land.’”
Di Lord God show me: see, basket of summer fruit.
E talk, “Amos, wetin you see?” I talk, “Basket of summer fruit.” Den di Lord talk to me, “Di end don come on my people Israel. I no go pass by dem again any more.
Di songs of di temple go be wailing for dat day,” talk di Lord God. “Di dead bodies go be many. For every place dem go throw dem out in silence.”
Hear dis, una wey trample on di needy, and cause di poor of di land to fail,
saying, “When di new moon go pass, so that we go sell grain? And di Sabbath, so that we go offer wheat for sale, make di ephah small, and di shekel great, and deal falsely with balances of deceit,
so that we go buy di poor for silver, and di needy for pair of sandals, and sell di sweepings of di wheat?”
Di Lord don swear by di pride of Jacob, “Surely I no go ever forget any of dem works.
Di land no go tremble for dis, and everyone mourn wey dwell inside am? Yes, e go rise up wholly like di River. E go dey stirred up and dey sink again, like di river of Egypt.
E go happen for dat day,” talk di Lord God, “say I go cause di sun to go down at noon, and I go darken di earth for di clear day.

I go turn una feasts into mourning, and all una songs into lamentation. I go bring sackcloth on all loins, and baldness on every head. I go make am like mourning for only son, and di end of am like bitter day.
See, di days dey come,” talk di Lord God, “wey I go send famine for di land, no famine of bread, nor thirst for water, but of hearing di words of di Lord.
Dem go wander from sea to sea, and from di north even to di east. Dem go run to and fro to seek di word of di Lord, and dem no go find am.
For dat day di beautiful virgins and di young men go faint for thirst.
Dem wey swear by di sin of Samaria, and talk, ‘As your god live, Dan,’ and, ‘As di way of Beersheba live,’ even dem go fall, and no go rise up again.”

I see di Lord standing beside di altar, and e talk, “Strike di capitals, so that di thresholds go shake, and break dem in pieces on di head of all of dem. I go kill di last of dem with di sword. No one of dem go flee away, and no one of dem go escape.
Though dem dig into Sheol, from dere my hand go take dem. Though dem climb up to heaven, from dere I go bring dem down.

Though dem hide demselves for di top of Carmel, I go search and take dem out from dere. Though dem dey hidden from my sight for di bottom of di sea, from dere I go command di serpent, and e go bite dem.
Though dem go into captivity before dem enemies, from dere I go command di sword, and e go kill dem. I go set my eyes on dem for evil, and no for good.”
Di Lord, di Lord of Armies, na im touch di land and e melt, and all wey dwell inside am go mourn. All of am go rise up like di River, and go sink again, like di river of Egypt.
Na im build im stairs for di heavens, and don found im vault on di earth. Na im call for di waters of di sea, and pour dem out on di surface of di earth. Di Lord na im name.
“Una no dey like di children of di Ethiopians to me, una children of Israel?” talk di Lord. “I no bring Israel up out of di land of Egypt, and di Philistines from Caphtor, and di Syrians from Kir?
See, di eyes of di Lord God dey on di sinful kingdom, and I go destroy am from off di surface of di earth, except say I no go utterly destroy di house of Jacob,” talk di Lord.
“Because see, I go command, and I go sift di house of Israel among all di nations, like as grain dey sifted for sieve, yet no small stone go fall on di earth.
All di sinners of my people go die by di sword, wey talk, ‘Di evil no go overtake nor meet us.’
For dat day I go raise up di tent of David wey dey fallen, and close up im breaches, and raise up im ruins, and I go build am as for di days of old,
so that dem go possess di remnant of Edom, and all di nations wey dem call by my name,” talk di Lord wey do dis.
“See, di days dey come,” talk di Lord, “wey di plowman go overtake di reaper, and di one wey tread grapes im wey sow seed. Di mountains go drip sweet wine, and all di hills go melt.
I go bring again di captivity of my people Israel. Dem go build di waste cities, and inhabit dem. Dem go plant vineyards, and drink dem wine. Dem go also make gardens, and eat dem fruit.
I go plant dem on dem land, and dem no go dey plucked up any more out of dem land wey I don give dem,” talk di Lord your God.
